b1-guerrafria-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Two Blocs
b1-guerrafria-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the Cold War, and he asks what the two blocs were.
b1-guerrafria-01.prompt: Tell Carlos about the two superpowers and what they defended.
cues: Say which country led one bloc and what it defended
Say which country led the other bloc and what it defended
b1-guerrafria-01.target: Estados Unidos, que defendía el capitalismo, dirigía un bloque. La Unión Soviética, que defendía el comunismo, dirigía el otro.
b1-guerrafria-01.english: The United States, which defended capitalism, led one bloc. The Soviet Union, which defended communism, led the other.
b1-guerrafria-01.canDo: I can add information about the two blocs with *que* and *quien*.

b1-guerrafria-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Rio Treaty
b1-guerrafria-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg is reading about the Cold War in a book for her class and asks you about the Rio Treaty.
b1-guerrafria-02.prompt: Tell Meg when and where the Rio Treaty was signed.
cues: Say that the treaty was signed in 1947
b1-guerrafria-02.target: En 1947 se firmó en Río de Janeiro el Tratado de Río.
b1-guerrafria-02.english: In 1947 the Rio Treaty was signed in Rio de Janeiro.
b1-guerrafria-02.canDo: I can say what was signed and founded using *se*.

b1-guerrafria-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Guerrillas
b1-guerrafria-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just seen a museum exhibition about the 1960s, and he asks what the guerrilla fighters did.
b1-guerrafria-03.prompt: Tell Carlos how the guerrilla fighters lived in the mountains.
cues: Say that they spent months in the mountains
Say what they were doing there at the same time
b1-guerrafria-03.target: Los guerrilleros pasaban meses en las montañas, planeando ataques.
b1-guerrafria-03.english: The guerrilla fighters spent months in the mountains, planning attacks.
b1-guerrafria-03.canDo: I can say what two things a person did at the same time with the gerund.

b1-guerrafria-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Guatemala, 1954
b1-guerrafria-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks about a documentary you saw on the coup in Guatemala.
b1-guerrafria-04.prompt: Tell Meg who organised the operation in 1954, citing the source.
cues: Begin by citing the documents published later
b1-guerrafria-04.target: Según documentos publicados después por el gobierno de Estados Unidos, la CIA organizó la operación.
b1-guerrafria-04.english: According to documents published later by the US government, the CIA organised the operation.
b1-guerrafria-04.canDo: I can report what a source says with *según* and *dijo que*.

b1-guerrafria-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Secret Documents
b1-guerrafria-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are telling Carlos what you learned in a class on the Cold War about the archives.
b1-guerrafria-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the documents were like before and what historians have done now.
cues: Say that before, the documents were secret
Say that historians have studied them
b1-guerrafria-05.target: Antes los documentos eran secretos, pero los historiadores han podido estudiarlos.
b1-guerrafria-05.english: Before, the documents were secret, but historians have been able to study them.
b1-guerrafria-05.canDo: I can contrast how things were with what has changed, using the imperfect and the present perfect.

b1-guerrafria-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Cold War in Latin America
b1-guerrafria-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are talking after a class about the Cold War in Latin America.
b1-guerrafria-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened in 1947 and 1948.
cues: Say that a treaty was signed in 1947
Say that the OAS was founded in 1948
b1-guerrafria-consolidation.target: En 1947 se firmó el Tratado de Río, y en 1948 se fundó la OEA en Bogotá.
b1-guerrafria-consolidation.english: In 1947 the Rio Treaty was signed, and in 1948 the OAS was founded in Bogotá.
b1-guerrafria-consolidation.canDo: I can say how the world split into two blocs and what containment was.
